turns.text: Do I need WASA if I already have a Safe-to-Host certificate?

No additional WASA is required if a valid Safe to Host certificate already exists for the application. If that certificate has expired, it must be renewed; the Safe to Host certificate is the output of a WASA audit.
I made a small bug fix after the audit, do I need to redo it?

must_contain: a new WASA is required again only if the change is major or touches the backend
